title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod).
statusReason: Normalized non-conforming status/phase values ("accepted"/"in-progress" are not in the platform's allowed set). This is a perpetual rolling observation log, not a single decision awaiting closure, so it takes active/informational rather than decided; it stays off the History track by design. AGT-2663 and AGT-2664 remain open in 3-progress; the rest of the referenced cards are archived.
